BrochureContent.Content:
City Properties are proud to bring this amazing Two bedroom, two bathroom apartment to the property market.
Apartment 212 Swiftwood is a very bright spacious two bedroom first floor apartment extending to 90 sq m. Situated in this beautifully landscaped and highly sought after gated development known as Swiftwood, the property has a fabulous balcony spanning the full width of apartment.
Internally the extensive accommodation comprises an inviting L shaped hall with a generous storage area off, a bright living room with french doors opening to a fabulous balcony and a modern kitchen with a tiled floor and range of built in units and appliances. There are two spacious double bedrooms (master en-suite) and a main bathroom both with french doors leading out to the beautiful tiled balcony area. The property is located opposite Citywest Hotel and Golf Club in the heart of Saggart village close to many amenities including local shops and Citywest shopping centre, various leisure facilities, fabulous restuarants, Citywest business park and with easy access to the N.7, M50, M4 and Saggart LUAS stop. This is a superb opportunity for a discerning purchaser to acquire a superb apartment in a desirable location.
